title: Search is case-sensitive: "Anna" and "anna" find nothing
hint: Search for any employee by their full first name.
explanation: The query is lowercased, the names in the data are not. Only fragments without a capital letter match, like "nna".

title: The search query is rendered as HTML (HTML injection / XSS)
hint: What happens if you search for markup instead of text?
explanation: The "No results" message is built as a string and inserted with innerHTML. A query like runs a script.

title: The department filter does not reset the page: the table is empty
hint: Go to a later page, then change the department.
explanation: The page number is kept after the filter changes. If the department has fewer rows, an empty page is shown.

title: Typo in the filter: "Acounting"
hint: Read the list of departments in the filter.
explanation: The dropdown is missing a "c", while the table spells the department correctly.

title: Sorting by salary compares strings
hint: Sort by salary and compare neighbouring values of different length.
explanation: Numbers are compared as strings, so 95000 ends up "greater" than 120000.

title: Sorting by hire date orders by day, not by date
hint: Sort by date and look at the years.
explanation: Dates in DD/MM/YYYY format are compared as strings, so the order follows the day of the month.

title: The sort arrow points the wrong way
hint: Check the arrow direction against how the rows are actually sorted.
explanation: Ascending sort draws a down arrow, descending sort draws an up arrow.

title: Sorting is not available from the keyboard
hint: Try to sort the table without a mouse.
explanation: The click handler sits on a th with no button inside. The header cannot get focus, Enter and Space do nothing.

title: The "of N" counter shows the total number of records, ignoring filters
hint: Compare the counter under the table before and after filtering.
explanation: The range is computed from filtered data, the total comes from the full list.

title: One employee's salary shows as "$null"
hint: Page through the whole table and look at the salary column.
explanation: An empty salary is not handled and is formatted as a string. Show "-" or "not set" instead.

title: The last page is unreachable: "Next" gets disabled too early
hint: Walk to the end of the list with the "Next" button.
explanation: The button is disabled at page >= pageCount - 1 instead of page >= pageCount, so the last page never opens.
